title: Surreal Fleur-de-Lis Dreamscape
description: A large dripping golden fleur-de-lis dominates the center of a cosmic night scene. A woman in a white dress with a blue bow sits on a riverbank beside a winding galaxy river containing melting clocks, floating heart bubbles with miniature landscapes, and a floating heart-shaped island with trees and clocks in the sky.
prompt: Surreal painting featuring a large melting golden fleur-de-lis with dripping texture at the center. A winding river made of starry galaxy flows through a black landscape. In the foreground a woman in a flowing white dress with large blue bow sits on the bank surrounded by melting clocks and pink petals. Floating transparent bubbles contain miniature gardens and hearts. In the sky a heart-shaped floating island with trees and melting clocks hovers above a vibrant colorful nebula and shooting stars.
